title: Microsoft Purview: Azure PST Import to Exchange Online mailboxes
summary: The briefing matches the roadmap and Microsoft's supplied notice, including the revised rollout windows and administrator-led workflow. The published bulk-import licensing, Azure storage meters and Azure role-assignment controls support its actionable guidance.

claims.claim: Azure PST Import is a Microsoft Purview Data Lifecycle Management feature.
claims.quote: "title": "Microsoft Purview: Data Lifecycle Management- Azure PST Import"

claims.claim: The planned feature imports PST files from Azure Blob Storage directly into Exchange Online mailboxes.
claims.quote: Azure PST Import is a migration method that enables PST files stored in Azure Blob Storage to be imported directly into Exchange Online mailboxes.

claims.claim: The feature follows the two-step Exchange Migration Service pattern of analysis followed by migration.
claims.quote: It follows the standard two‑step Exchange Migration Service pattern: an initial analysis phase to validate and assess PST data, followed by execution of the actual migration.

claims.claim: az role assignment create supports assigning Storage Blob Data Reader with --assignee-object-id, --assignee-principal-type and a storage-account --scope.

    --role "Storage Blob Data Reader" \
    --assignee-object-id "aaaaaaaa-0000-1111-2222-bbbbbbbbbbbb" \
    --assignee-principal-type "User" \
    --scope

claims.where: front matter: defaultState; Why it matters; rationale: risk
claims.claim: Azure PST Import requires administrator configuration and initiation rather than importing data automatically on arrival.
claims.quote: The process starts by creating an Azure PST Import endpoint to establish the connection between Azure storage and Exchange Online. Administrators then run a migration batch in Analyze mode to review readiness and validate the input before proceeding.

claims.claim: Published Learn guidance does not yet identify usable Azure PST Import cmdlets or their specific Exchange or Purview roles.
claims.quote: Searched: "Azure PST Import" migration endpoint cmdlets licensing; "New-MigrationEndpoint" "PSTImport". Read New-MigrationEndpoint (-PSTImport is on-premises/internal only), New-MailboxImportRequest excerpts (not supported in Exchange Online), and pst-import-overview.
